subjects.name: Science
subjects.description: Observe plants, animals and the world around you.

lessons.title: Build a Plant Friend
lessons.topic: Identifying the parts of a plant
lessons.outcome: I can identify roots, stem, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds.

lessons.title: Plant Shape Garden
lessons.topic: Trees, shrubs, herbs, climbers and creepers
lessons.outcome: I can group familiar plants using their stems and growth habits.

lessons.title: Leaf Detective
lessons.topic: Comparing leaves by visible features
lessons.outcome: I can compare leaves by their colour, shape and size.

lessons.title: Tree Neighbourhood
lessons.topic: How animals use plants for food and shelter
lessons.outcome: I can explain how a plant helps nearby animals.

lessons.title: Soil Window
lessons.topic: Observing soil and the life within it
lessons.outcome: I can describe soil and recognise things found within it.

lessons.title: A Seed’s New Home
lessons.topic: Animals helping seeds reach new places
lessons.outcome: I can describe one way an animal helps a plant spread.

lessons.title: Rain on My Street
lessons.topic: Rainwater on soil and hard ground
lessons.outcome: I can compare water soaking into soil, collecting and flowing away.

lessons.title: Follow the Water
lessons.topic: Sources of water and its journey to homes
lessons.outcome: I can trace one route by which water reaches a home.

lessons.title: Every Drop Helper
lessons.topic: Using water carefully and avoiding wastage
lessons.outcome: I can choose a daily action that wastes less water.

lessons.title: Food Source Trail
lessons.topic: Foods from plants and animals
lessons.outcome: I can trace familiar food ingredients to plants or animals.

lessons.title: Harvest the Plant
lessons.topic: Plant parts that we eat
lessons.outcome: I can match a familiar food to the plant part it comes from.

lessons.title: Colourful Thali Builder
lessons.topic: Eating a variety of foods
lessons.outcome: I can explain why eating different kinds of food matters.

lessons.title: Healthy Day Planner
lessons.topic: Daily cleanliness and handwashing habits
lessons.outcome: I can choose suitable times to wash hands and keep clean.

lessons.title: Move and Notice
lessons.topic: Observing body changes during exercise and rest
lessons.outcome: I can notice that active play can make breathing faster and the body warmer.

lessons.title: Material Match Workshop
lessons.topic: Choosing materials for familiar objects
lessons.outcome: I can explain why a material suits a particular object.

lessons.title: Window Wonder
lessons.topic: Transparent, translucent and opaque materials
lessons.outcome: I can compare how clearly I can see through different materials.

lessons.title: Shape and Flow Lab
lessons.topic: Solids, liquids and gases in everyday observations
lessons.outcome: I can compare a stone, water and air using simple observations.

lessons.title: Build a Steady Wall
lessons.topic: Comparing brick arrangements in a wall
lessons.outcome: I can compare two wall arrangements under the same gentle push.

lessons.title: Two-Bin Town
lessons.topic: Separating common compostable and recyclable waste
lessons.outcome: I can separate common food/leaf waste from clean recyclable materials.

lessons.title: Low-Waste Party Planner
lessons.topic: Reducing waste and reusing everyday things
lessons.outcome: I can change a daily choice to create less waste.

subjects.name: Maths
subjects.description: Play with numbers, shapes, patterns and measurement.

lessons.title: Count Them Home
lessons.topic: Counting and recording a group with one mark per object
lessons.outcome: I can use marks to check whether every animal has returned.

lessons.title: Shape Toy Workshop
lessons.topic: Recognising and combining common solid shapes
lessons.outcome: I can identify shapes in a toy and describe their faces.

lessons.title: Number Builder
lessons.topic: Hundreds, tens and ones in three-digit numbers
lessons.outcome: I can build a number using hundreds, tens and ones.

lessons.title: Number Line Safari
lessons.topic: Comparing and ordering three-digit numbers
lessons.outcome: I can put numbers in order and explain which is larger.

lessons.title: Growing Number Garden
lessons.topic: Addition using place-value regrouping
lessons.outcome: I can combine two amounts and exchange ten tens for a hundred.

lessons.title: Pack the Saplings
lessons.topic: Subtraction using place-value exchanges
lessons.outcome: I can unpack a ten or hundred to find how many are left.

lessons.title: Bead Array Lab
lessons.topic: Multiplication as equal groups and arrays
lessons.outcome: I can count equal groups using repeated addition and multiplication.

lessons.title: Fair Sweet Shop
lessons.topic: Division through equal sharing
lessons.outcome: I can share objects equally and find each person’s share.

lessons.title: Half-and-Half Kitchen
lessons.topic: One half as one of two equal shares
lessons.outcome: I can check whether two pieces are equal halves of a whole.

lessons.title: Quarter Quilt
lessons.topic: Quarters and the relationship between halves and a whole
lessons.outcome: I can make quarters and see that two quarters make a half.

lessons.title: Dot-Grid Shape Studio
lessons.topic: Building and recognising flat shapes
lessons.outcome: I can recognise a shape even when its size or position changes.

lessons.title: Pattern Jump Track
lessons.topic: Extending number patterns with equal jumps
lessons.outcome: I can find the repeated change and predict the next number.

lessons.title: Whose Handspan?
lessons.topic: Measuring length with repeated informal units
lessons.outcome: I can measure a length without gaps and explain why unit size matters.

lessons.title: Metre Rope Explorer
lessons.topic: Comparing lengths with a metre, half metre and quarter metre
lessons.outcome: I can choose a metre-length rope and compare familiar lengths.

lessons.title: Pour and Compare
lessons.topic: Capacity using litres, half litres and quarter litres
lessons.outcome: I can compare containers using a common amount of water.

lessons.title: Balance Basket
lessons.topic: Comparing weight with a pan balance
lessons.outcome: I can use a balance to identify heavier, lighter and equal weights.

lessons.title: Mini Mela Money
lessons.topic: Making the same money amount in different ways
lessons.outcome: I can pay the same whole-rupee price using different combinations.

lessons.title: Calendar Quest
lessons.topic: Reading a calendar and counting days
lessons.outcome: I can find a date, its weekday and a date a few days later.

lessons.title: Move the Clock
lessons.topic: Reading an analogue clock at hours, quarter past and half past
lessons.outcome: I can show a time and see how both clock hands move.

lessons.title: Mirror Rangoli
lessons.topic: Mirror symmetry in patterns
lessons.outcome: I can complete the matching half of a design across a line.

subjects.name: English
subjects.description: Build words, explore sentences and practise reading.

lessons.title: Sound Launchpad
lessons.topic: Hear and build beginning consonant blends
lessons.outcome: Hear and read familiar words beginning with gr, cr, dr and pr.

lessons.title: Alphabet Shelf
lessons.topic: Arrange words in alphabetical order
lessons.outcome: Order familiar words by their first letter.

lessons.title: Word Joining Workshop
lessons.topic: Join two words to make a new word
lessons.outcome: Combine two familiar words and explain the new word using its picture.

lessons.title: Yesterday Replay
lessons.topic: Tell what happened using regular -ed words
lessons.outcome: Use familiar regular -ed words for completed actions.

lessons.title: Story Timeline
lessons.topic: Sequence a short picture story
lessons.outcome: Retell events in a sensible beginning-to-end order.

lessons.title: Talking Sentence Lab
lessons.topic: Choose a full stop or question mark
lessons.outcome: Distinguish a statement from a question and punctuate its end.

lessons.title: Sound Gate
lessons.topic: Choose a or an by the beginning sound
lessons.outcome: Use a or an before familiar singular naming words by listening to their first sound.

lessons.title: Action Playground
lessons.topic: Match action words to movement
lessons.outcome: Read and use everyday play-action words accurately.

lessons.title: Describe My Toy
lessons.topic: Add describing words to naming words
lessons.outcome: Use a simple describing word to give more information about an object.

lessons.title: One-to-Many Toy Shelf
lessons.topic: Make plurals with -s and -es
lessons.outcome: Change familiar singular words into regular plurals.

lessons.title: Character Sentence Switch
lessons.topic: Replace repeated names with he or she
lessons.outcome: Connect he or she to an already introduced character.

lessons.title: Move the Toy
lessons.topic: Describe position with in, on and under
lessons.outcome: Choose a position word that correctly describes an object's location.

lessons.title: Animal Word Trail
lessons.topic: Learn familiar male and female animal words
lessons.outcome: Recognise familiar paired animal names in spoken and written English.

lessons.title: Opposite Slider
lessons.topic: Explore words with opposite meanings
lessons.outcome: Choose an opposite word to describe a changed observable property.

lessons.title: Sentence Number Switch
lessons.topic: Use is and are with one or many
lessons.outcome: Use is with a singular naming word and are with a plural naming word.

lessons.title: Sentence Bridges
lessons.topic: Join simple ideas with and or but
lessons.outcome: Use and to add a related idea and but to express a simple contrast.

lessons.title: Word Basket Market
lessons.topic: Group familiar food words by meaning
lessons.outcome: Read familiar food names and group them under meaningful labels.

lessons.title: Clue Detective
lessons.topic: Understand and give simple descriptive clues
lessons.outcome: Use a short description to identify an object and give a useful clue.

lessons.title: My Moon Postcard
lessons.topic: Write a few connected descriptive sentences
lessons.outcome: Create a short, meaningful description from an observed picture.

lessons.title: Week Word Wheel
lessons.topic: Read weekdays and first-to-seventh order words
lessons.outcome: Read weekday names and connect first through seventh to positions in a displayed week.

subjects.name: Hindi
subjects.description: शब्द, वाक्य और कहानियों के साथ सीखें।

lessons.title: शब्दों की दोस्ती
lessons.topic: समान अर्थ वाले शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा परिचित शब्द का समान अर्थ वाला शब्द पहचानकर वाक्य में प्रयोग करेगा।

lessons.title: सुनो और शब्द चुनो
lessons.topic: ड़ और ढ़ की ध्वनि व पहचान
lessons.outcome: बच्चा सुनकर और पढ़कर ड़ तथा ढ़ वाले परिचित शब्दों में अंतर पहचानेगा।

lessons.title: तुक की रेल
lessons.topic: तुक मिलने वाले शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा सुनकर तुक वाले शब्द चुनेगा और छोटी मौलिक पंक्ति पूरी करेगा।

lessons.title: अंकों के तीन रूप
lessons.topic: एक से दस तक अंक और संख्या-शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा एक से दस तक संख्या-शब्दों को देवनागरी और प्रचलित अंकों से मिलाएगा।

lessons.title: उलटे अर्थ का झूला
lessons.topic: विपरीत अर्थ वाले शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा दृश्य के बदलने पर सही विपरीत अर्थ वाला शब्द चुनेगा।

lessons.title: एक से अनेक का बगीचा
lessons.topic: एकवचन से बहुवचन
lessons.outcome: बच्चा एक से अधिक वस्तुएँ होने पर परिचित शब्द का सही बहुवचन बोलेगा और चुनेगा।

lessons.title: कहानी का क्रम बनाओ
lessons.topic: घटनाओं और निर्देशों का सही क्रम
lessons.outcome: बच्चा छोटे निर्देश पढ़कर बताएगा कि पहले, फिर और अंत में क्या करना है।

lessons.title: कौन है, क्या करता है?
lessons.topic: नाम वाले और काम वाले शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा छोटे वाक्य में नाम बताने और काम बताने वाले शब्द अलग करेगा।

lessons.title: वर्णन वाला डिब्बा
lessons.topic: विशेषता बताने वाले शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा परिचित वस्तु या जीव की विशेषता बताने वाला उपयुक्त शब्द चुनेगा।

lessons.title: वाक्य की छोटी कड़ियाँ
lessons.topic: छूटे छोटे शब्द जोड़कर वाक्य सुधारना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा अर्थ स्पष्ट करने के लिए वाक्य में छूटा में, के, की या ने जोड़ेगा।

lessons.title: मेरा पत्रघर
lessons.topic: मित्र को छोटा पत्र लिखना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा संबोधन, अपनी दो बातें और समापन जोड़कर मित्र के लिए छोटा पत्र बनाएगा।

lessons.title: संयुक्त अक्षर कार्यशाला
lessons.topic: त्र और श्र से शब्द बनाना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा त्र और श्र को पहचानकर उनसे बने परिचित शब्द पढ़ेगा।

lessons.title: मात्रा का जादू
lessons.topic: मात्रा हटने से शब्द और अर्थ बदलना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा परिचित शब्द से मात्रा हटाकर बने सही शब्द का अर्थ बताएगा।

lessons.title: शब्दों का पिटारा
lessons.topic: बिखरे अक्षरों से सही शब्द
lessons.outcome: बच्चा अक्षर-समूह सही क्रम में रखकर परिचित शब्द बनाएगा और पढ़ेगा।

lessons.title: कारण खोजो कहानी में
lessons.topic: कहानी में कारण समझना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा छोटी कहानी पढ़कर किसी पात्र के व्यवहार का कारण बताएगा।

lessons.title: विराम चिह्न की चौकी
lessons.topic: पूर्ण विराम और प्रश्न चिह्न
lessons.outcome: बच्चा सामान्य कथन और प्रश्न के अंत में उचित चिह्न लगाएगा।

lessons.title: एक शब्द, दो दृश्य
lessons.topic: एक शब्द के अलग संदर्भों में अर्थ
lessons.outcome: बच्चा छोटे वाक्य के आधार पर परिचित बहुअर्थी शब्द का सही अर्थ चुनेगा।

lessons.title: शब्दों की यात्रा
lessons.topic: यान जोड़कर नए शब्द बनाना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा यान जोड़कर परिचित नए शब्द बनाएगा और उनका अर्थ समझाएगा।

lessons.title: चंद्रबिंदु खोजी
lessons.topic: चंद्रबिंदु वाले शब्द पहचानना
lessons.outcome: बच्चा चंद्रबिंदु वाले परिचित शब्द खोजेगा और सुनकर पढ़ेगा।

lessons.title: शब्द और वाक्य का मेल
lessons.topic: स्त्रीलिंग-पुल्लिंग के अनुसार वाक्य का मेल
lessons.outcome: बच्चा परिचित नाम वाले शब्द के अनुसार गया या गई जैसे सही रूप का चुनाव करेगा।

subjects.name: Computer
subjects.description: Try drawing tools, computer parts and practice documents.

lessons.title: Computer Team Builder
lessons.topic: Computer parts and their jobs
lessons.outcome: Match familiar computer parts to their jobs.

lessons.title: Message Journey
lessons.topic: Input, processing and output
lessons.outcome: Follow an input through processing to an output.

lessons.title: Ready, Work, Rest
lessons.topic: Starting and shutting down
lessons.outcome: Order a supervised start and shutdown routine.

lessons.title: Keyboard Garden
lessons.topic: Alphabet and number keys
lessons.outcome: Locate and use letters and digits on a keyboard.

lessons.title: Message Repair Shop
lessons.topic: Special keys and the text cursor
lessons.outcome: Use special keys to correct a short message.

lessons.title: Mouse Explorer
lessons.topic: Mouse buttons and scrolling
lessons.outcome: Distinguish selecting, opening a shortcut menu and scrolling.

lessons.title: Friendly Lab
lessons.topic: Caring for the computer lab
lessons.outcome: Choose careful behaviour around shared computer equipment.

lessons.title: Digital Sketch Garden
lessons.topic: Drawing with pencil, brush and eraser
lessons.outcome: Choose a drawing tool and revise a picture.

lessons.title: Colour Match Workshop
lessons.topic: Fill colour and colour picker
lessons.outcome: Fill a region and reuse a sampled colour.

lessons.title: Build a Park Sign
lessons.topic: Shapes and labels in a drawing
lessons.outcome: Combine ready-made shapes and a short text label.

lessons.title: Move the Flower
lessons.topic: Selecting and moving part of a picture
lessons.outcome: Select a picture region and move the selection.

lessons.title: Tiny Detail Detective
lessons.topic: Zooming in and out of a picture
lessons.outcome: Change the view to inspect picture details.

lessons.title: My Practice Desktop
lessons.topic: Desktop icons and open applications
lessons.outcome: Use icons to open and switch between activities.

lessons.title: Lost Drawing Rescue
lessons.topic: The Recycle Bin and restoring a file
lessons.outcome: Restore a practice file from a simulated bin.

lessons.title: My Tiny Notebook
lessons.topic: Creating, saving and opening a document
lessons.outcome: Create and retrieve a named practice document.

lessons.title: Sentence Sticker Lab
lessons.topic: Selecting, cutting, copying and pasting text
lessons.outcome: Distinguish copying text from moving it.

lessons.title: Poster Word Studio
lessons.topic: Changing text appearance
lessons.outcome: Format selected text to make a heading noticeable.

lessons.title: Picnic List Maker
lessons.topic: Bullets, numbering and text alignment
lessons.outcome: Arrange a short list and position its heading.

lessons.title: Little Web Window
lessons.topic: Internet, websites and the browser
lessons.outcome: Use a browser model to visit a provided website.

lessons.title: Picture Search Detective
lessons.topic: Searching for and saving an image
lessons.outcome: Search a curated collection and save a matching image.
